description: Show your Lichess or Chess.com profile, ratings, results and recent games

profile.description: Avatar, title, name, country, join date and followers or play time
profile.name: Profile

ratings_show_best.description: The highest rating reached in each time control
ratings_show_best.label: Show best rating

ratings_show_puzzles.label: Show puzzles

ratings_show_unplayed.description: Time controls you never played, with a dash
ratings_show_unplayed.label: Show unplayed time controls

ratings.description: Current and best rating per time control, and games played
ratings.name: Ratings

recent_games.description: Your latest games: result, opponent, time control and date
recent_games.name: Recent Games

results.description: Wins, draws and losses in bullet, blitz, rapid, classical and daily games
results.name: Results
